internship.title: Next.js Development Internship
internship.description: A role-specific Next.js Development Internship where students learn through realistic requirements, implementation, testing, review and delivery.
internship.learningModel: learn -> inspect -> implement -> test -> review -> iterate -> deliver
expectations: Complete every practical and dedicated task.
Verify work instead of assuming it works.
completionRequirements: Explain submitted work during final review.

lessons.title: Next.js Onboarding — Internship Lesson
lessons.description: Understand App Router project structure, conventions, layouts and server/client boundaries.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept to a realistic internship project.

notes.text: Understand App Router project structure, conventions, layouts and server/client boundaries.

This module follows a real engineering workflow. Students should inspect the existing project before changing it, understand the requirement, implement a focused solution, verify it, document important decisions and prepare it for review.

notes.caption: Add a dedicated diagram or annotated screenshot showing Next.js Onboarding in a real development workflow.

notes.text: First understand the problem, then the underlying production Next.js full-stack web development concept, then apply it to the project. The student should be able to explain both what was done and why.

items: Read the requirement or issue.
Inspect existing code and data flow.
Break the work into small changes.
Implement the smallest correct solution.
Run tests/checks and inspect the result.
Test an edge or failure case.
Compare the result with acceptance criteria.
Document the implementation and limitations.

notes.code: Run and inspect a Next.js application.

items: Changing unfamiliar code without tracing its current behavior.
